title: Count Subarrays With Fixed Bounds
description: Given an integer array `nums` and bounds `minK` and `maxK`, count non-empty contiguous subarrays whose minimum equals `minK` and maximum equals `maxK`. Return the count. Input: `nums`, `minK`, and `maxK`. Output: the number of qualifying subarrays.
hints: Maintain the prefix or window information needed to count candidate ranges.
Check repeated values, extreme bounds, and cases with no valid segment.
